source: Curated subset of public-record exonerations. The full National Registry of Exonerations dataset (~3,600 cases) is at https://exonerationregistry.org/ but is behind Cloudflare protection. This subset includes well-documented exonerations drawn from Innocence Project case lists, NRE annual reports, and major investigative reporting.
